summary.headline: Sirius, Canopus, and Upper Effects
summary.text: Agricultural and omen lore links crop prospects to trial sowings before Sirius, the Dāshan calendar plant, and Canopus’s color, radiance, and nearby stars or comets. Chapter Three introduces vapor-formed upper effects and cites Ptolemy, Aristotle, Indian Brahmins, the Four Treatises, and the Fruit of the Sphere.
